server.name: donde-onde-where
server.title: Donde Onde Where
server.description: Editorial index of independent restaurants and bars, with current-momentum rankings by city and neighbourhood.

tools.name: dow_zones
tools.title: DOW — list zones in a city
tools.description: List the active zones (neighbourhoods) that donde-onde-where.com indexes for a city, with venue counts, hot-list density and velocity tier. DOW indexes ONLY these cities — the authoritative list, read live from the database when tools are listed: UK — Bath, Belfast, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Liverpool, Manchester; Portugal — Aveiro, Braga, Cascais, Coimbra, Ericeira, Guimarães, Lagos, Lisbon, Margem Sul, Porto, Setúbal, Tavira, Évora; Spain — Bilbao, Burgos, Cádiz, Girona, Granada, Marbella, Oviedo, San Sebastián, Santander, Santiago de Compostela, Seville, Valencia, Vigo. Any city not on that list is not indexed. Returns the live covered-city list when the requested city is not indexed. Zone slugs from this tool are the input to dow_hot_list and dow_zone_health.

city.description: City name in the UK, Portugal or Spain, e.g. "Porto", "Seville", "Manchester". Spanish cities use their English name where one exists (e.g. "Seville", not "Sevilla").

annotations.title: DOW — list zones in a city

tools.name: dow_hot_list
tools.title: DOW — hot list (current momentum)
tools.description: Independent restaurants and bars in a donde-onde-where.com city or zone, ranked by current momentum — review velocity, baseline rating and profile completeness. This measures which venues are gaining attention now, not all-time popularity. Chains, cafes and bakeries are excluded by editorial policy. DOW indexes a specific set of cities in the UK, Portugal and Spain; dow_zones returns the live covered-city list.

city.description: City name in the UK, Portugal or Spain, e.g. "Porto", "Seville", "Manchester".

zone.description: Optional zone slug, e.g. "boavista". Slugs come from dow_zones.

tools.name: dow_venue_lookup
tools.title: DOW — look up a venue by name
tools.description: Look up an independent restaurant or bar by name in the donde-onde-where.com index. Returns its editorial profile (quick verdict, book-if, signature dishes, best-for), rating, review count, hot score, and a link to its DOW page. Chains, cafes and bakeries are excluded by editorial policy. DOW indexes a specific set of cities in the UK, Portugal and Spain; dow_zones returns the live covered-city list.

annotations.title: DOW — look up a venue by name

tools.name: dow_zone_health
tools.title: DOW — zone health signals
tools.description: Zone-level signals for a donde-onde-where.com neighbourhood: venues tracked, average rating, median review count, count rated 4.5 stars and above, top hot score, velocity tier (A, B or C), and venues added in the last 30 days. Answers how dense or active a named zone is. Zone slugs come from dow_zones and are unique across cities.

zone.description: Zone slug, e.g. "cedofeita". Slugs come from dow_zones and are globally unique across cities.

tools.name: dow_recently_added
tools.title: DOW — recently added venues
tools.description: The most recently profiled restaurants and bars in a donde-onde-where.com city — venues that crossed DOW's editorial threshold inside the look-back window. Answers what is new in a city.

city.description: City name in the UK, Portugal or Spain, e.g. "Porto", "Seville", "Manchester".

tools.name: dow_open_for
tools.title: DOW — Hot List venues open on a day and time
tools.description: Use this whenever the person names a day or a time of day ("Sunday lunch", "Friday night drinks", "breakfast tomorrow", "open late"). Returns Hot List restaurants and bars in a city or zone that are open for the whole of that slot on that day, matched on opening hours only. Venues without readable opening hours are left out and counted. Convert "today", "tonight" or "tomorrow" to the weekday yourself. For a lively or busy place, pass sort "busiest", which orders by Google popular-times busyness at that hour where known. Zone slugs come from dow_zones.

city.description: City name in the UK, Portugal or Spain, e.g. "Porto", "Seville", "Manchester".

zone.description: Optional zone slug, e.g. "cedofeita". Slugs come from dow_zones.

slot.description: breakfast 09:00–10:00, lunch 13:30–14:30, afternoon 16:00–17:00, evening (dinner, drinks) 20:30–21:30, late 23:00–00:00.

sort.description: hot_score (default) or busiest, for a lively atmosphere.

annotations.title: DOW — Hot List venues open on a day and time

tools.name: dow_near
tools.title: DOW — Hot List venues near a point
tools.description: Use this for a "near me" question when the person gives a location as latitude and longitude. Returns the Hot List restaurants and bars of the donde-onde-where.com zone that contains that point, in Hot List order, each with its straight-line distance from the point. It does not rank by distance and gives no rank numbers. Optional dish or cuisine (not both) keeps only the venues named in a published DOW fact for that dish or cuisine in the zone; a dish or cuisine with no published fact returns no venues rather than a guess. A point outside every DOW zone returns no venues and names the nearest zone.

lat.description: Latitude of the point in decimal degrees, -90 to 90, e.g. 41.1407.

lng.description: Longitude of the point in decimal degrees, -180 to 180, e.g. -8.6119.

kind.description: Optional: restaurant or bar. Omit for both.

dish.description: Optional dish, 2 to 60 characters, e.g. "francesinha" or "bacalhau". Pass dish OR cuisine, not both.

cuisine.description: Optional cuisine, 2 to 60 characters, e.g. "italian". Pass cuisine OR dish, not both.

limit.description: 1 to 5, default 5. Max venues per zone.

annotations.title: DOW — Hot List venues near a point

tools.name: dow_ai_citation_status
tools.title: DOW — AI citation status for a venue
tools.description: Whether a venue appears in donde-onde-where.com's AI-citation probe corpus (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity). Returns citation counts by model and the recent probe queries that surfaced it. Absence means the venue did not surface in the probes that ran — it is a sample, not a statement about the whole web. Name the venue directly; a Google Place ID may be given instead if one is already known.

venue.description: Venue name, e.g. "À Bolina". Resolved to the single best DOW match.

city.description: Optional city to disambiguate the venue name, e.g. "Porto".

place_id.description: Google Place ID (starts with "ChIJ"), if already known. Prefer `venue`.

annotations.title: DOW — AI citation status for a venue
